svg.aria-label: V6 Phase 1 use cases: author a spec, commit through the gate, open a PR, set up a new repo
svg.title: MODEL-AFC-V6 — Phase 1 use cases and outcomes: UC-T1 author a spec with spec-authoring, UC-T2 commit through the gate, UC-T3 open a pull request, UC-T4 set up a new repo (diagram-assisted, no SysML claim)
svg.desc: Phase 1 only. Four tooling goals with observable outcomes: a lint-clean built spec with byte-identical rebuild; a PASS or typed FAIL/GAP verdict identical from every gate entry point; a PR gate table with vnv-review findings or REFUSED_NO_VNV merged by rebase; a new repo with gate, workflow and hooks wired and verified.

g.text: V6 — Phase 1 use cases and outcomes (MODEL-AFC-V6)
Planned design, not realized. diagram-assisted view; no SysML claim.
UC-T1: author a spec with spec-authoring
Actor: agent in any repo with the D5 skill (repo-agnostic)
copy template → fill spec.yaml → author sections
draw figures → build → lint until clean
Outcome: one built spec file, lint-clean,
byte-identical rebuild (CONTRACT-AFC-SPECKIT)
via: D5 skill (S06), vendored tools/spec/ (S42)
while no spec/ exists, the gate self-checks the template
UC-T2: commit through the gate
Actor: agent committing or pushing
local .githooks/ or harness pre-tool hook
runs gate.sh over spec, docs, hygiene
Outcome: PASS or typed FAIL / GAP,
same verdict from every entry point
via: gate.sh (S09), hook installer (S11)
UC-T3: open a pull request
Actor: agent via ship-pull-request
gate table per check; vnv-review PROFILE
against docs/vnv/ (ci-cd, spec, developer-feedback)
Outcome: findings join the repair round,
or REFUSED_NO_VNV; merge by rebase, never squash
via: ship-pull-request (S03), Vnv tree (S07)
UC-T4: set up a new repo
Actor: owner or agent with the D4 skills
setup-pre-commit: gate.sh + .githooks/
setup-a-repo: ci.yml per workflow rules
Outcome: gate + workflow + hooks wired,
verified with a deliberate failing change
Phase 1 has no product use cases: UC-T1..UC-T4 are tooling goals. Product use cases return in the spec track (ST-3); V2 stays reference input.
Blue capsules = use case + outcome. Gray lines = supporting slice. Source: views/v6-phase1-use-cases.mmd.
